mapping: exact BUSCO gene-body intervals to existing local chr16 tree windows; overlapping intervals deduplicated by window per site
site_filter: biallelic A/C/G/T; DP>=3; male diploid GT must be homozygous and is recoded haploid; require complete calls in the entire calculation group at the site
ascertainment: variant-only FreeBayes callset; records include target gene bodies only and upstream source filter completeness is not demonstrated; outputs are observed-panel exploratory D, not asserted unbiased classical SFS
